description: This file provides utility functions and type definitions for parsing, normalizing, and checking IP addresses (IPv4 and IPv6). It includes functions for embedded IPv4 extraction, CIDR matching, and address range classification, with a focus on special-use and private ranges.

methods.name: stripIpv6Brackets
methods.description: Removes brackets from IPv6 address strings if present.

methods.name: isNumericIpv4LiteralPart
methods.description: Checks if a string is a numeric or hexadecimal IPv4 literal part.

methods.name: parseIpv6WithEmbeddedIpv4
methods.description: Parses IPv6 addresses with embedded IPv4 addresses.

methods.name: normalizeIpv4MappedAddress
methods.description: Converts IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses to IPv4 addresses.

methods.name: normalizeIpParseInput
methods.description: Trims and strips brackets from raw IP address input.

methods.name: parseCanonicalIpAddress
methods.description: Parses IP address string into canonical IPv4 or IPv6 address.

methods.name: parseLooseIpAddress
methods.description: Parses IP address string with leniency, including embedded IPv4.

methods.name: normalizeIpAddress
methods.description: Normalizes IP address string to lowercase, IPv4-mapped addresses to IPv4.

methods.name: isCanonicalDottedDecimalIPv4
methods.description: Checks if a string is a canonical dotted decimal IPv4 address.

methods.name: isLegacyIpv4Literal
methods.description: Checks if a string is a legacy IPv4 literal (non-dotted, non-standard).

methods.name: isLoopbackIpAddress
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is a loopback address.

methods.name: isPrivateOrLoopbackIpAddress
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is private or loopback.

methods.name: isBlockedSpecialUseIpv6Address
methods.description: Checks if an IPv6 address is in a special-use range.

methods.name: isRfc1918Ipv4Address
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address is RFC1918 private range.

methods.name: isCarrierGradeNatIpv4Address
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address is in the carrier-grade NAT range.

methods.name: isBlockedSpecialUseIpv4Address
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address is in a blocked or special-use range, with options for RFC2544 benchmark range.

methods.name: decodeIpv4FromHextets
methods.description: Decodes IPv4 address from high and low 16-bit hextets.

methods.name: extractEmbeddedIpv4FromIpv6
methods.description: Extracts embedded IPv4 address from IPv6 address if present.

methods.name: isIpInCidr
methods.description: Checks if an IP address belongs to a given CIDR range.
